I learn by building.

I'm Mahammad Afshaan, a Computer Science & Business Systems student who enjoys turning ideas into working systems. I build full-stack applications, experiment with AI agents and LLMs, and use cybersecurity projects to understand secure system design.


I'm also strengthening DSA and C++ for placements and using every project, hackathon and collaboration as an opportunity to improve my technical depth.

Security mindset.

Cybersecurity is one of my major areas of exploration. I want to understand not only how applications work, but also how systems can be designed with privacy, security and resilience in mind.

AI curiosity.

I'm actively learning modern AI concepts including LLMs, RAG, LangChain and LangGraph, with the goal of turning them into useful real-world applications.

Communication & leadership.

Volunteering at CODE KUDLA 2026 helped me strengthen communication and organization by working with founders, mentors, participants and the organizing team while learning from real projects.
